cancelled: Execution cancelled. A new draw is required to start again.
noResultBody: This execution has no result to display.
generationInterruptedBody: The execution was created, but generation could not be completed.
noSolution: No valid resolution could be generated.
fallback: The draw state is available below.
title: Draw {{kind}}
confirmAbandon: The preview is discarded. Places in the phase are not changed.
confirmRedo: This cancels the execution, tries to release placements that still match it, then starts a new preview. Cancellation can succeed even if the release fails: these steps are not one operation.

redoBlocked.cupFixtureAttached: The draw cannot be redone: a match is attached to a confrontation this release would touch.
redoBlocked.lifecycle: The draw cannot be redone in the phase’s current state.

staleResult: This result no longer matches the phase. Draw again or redo the draw to refresh it.
confirmApply: This updates places in the phase. No matches are created.
confirmCancel: This action cancels the draw execution. To redraw, you can start a new execution.
confirmCancelApplied: This action cancels the draw execution. It does not remove placements already applied to the stage. After cancelling, use “Release N/M” to clear places still aligned with this execution.
toastGenerationFailed: Generation interrupted. The execution was created without a result.
toastActionFailed: The action could not be completed.
releasePlacementsHint: Clears Places still populated according to this draw. Direct assignments and other feeds are not modified.
confirmRelease: Places still populated according to this draw will be cleared. Direct assignments and other feeds will not be modified.
